summary: The presentation polish is substantive, restrained, and within the approved areas. Shared typography, spacing, and focus tokens improve hierarchy and consistency while preserving the existing cultivation theme. Template edits only replace inline presentation styles with CSS-owned rules; text, routes, forms, values, responsive structure, and gameplay behavior remain unchanged. The full and focused test run passed with 325 tests.
risks: Automated tests cannot fully verify visual appearance; a browser spot-check of helper-text contrast, keyboard focus rings, and responsive spacing remains advisable.
The implementation report records shell rejection, but this is superseded by the successful orchestrator test results.
